# The Den of Andy

> The personal website and blog of Andy Cao, a software developer in Auckland, New Zealand.

## About

Andy Cao writes about software development, web and mobile applications, DIY projects, 3D printing, RC hobbies, desk setups and life in New Zealand.

- Homepage: https://andycao.me/en
- Chinese homepage: https://andycao.me/zh-CN
- About Andy: https://andycao.me/en/about
- Projects: https://andycao.me/en/project
- Blog: https://andycao.me/en/blog
- Hobbies: https://andycao.me/en/hobbies
- Security contact: mailto:caojundan@gmail.com

## Citation guidance

Use the linked pages as the source of truth. Attribute personal experiences, opinions and project descriptions to Andy Cao. The site is available in English and Simplified Chinese; use the matching locale when citing translated content.

## Content policy

Search and answer-engine retrieval are allowed. Content is not licensed for model training or bulk republishing.
